name: InsightfulPipe — Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, SEO, Social & Shopify
description:
InsightfulPipe connects Claude to the marketing, analytics, SEO, social, and e-commerce platforms your business already runs on, so you can ask questions in plain language instead of exporting spreadsheets and stitching them together by hand.

Paid ads: Google Ads, Meta (Facebook and Instagram) Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, Snapchat Ads, and X Ads — spend, campaign performance, and conversions, plus competitor research through public ad libraries.

SEO and site health: Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, and DataForSEO for SERPs, keyword rankings, and backlinks, plus a built-in crawler, PageSpeed Insights, and Google Tag Manager.

Analytics: Google Analytics 4, Microsoft Clarity, CallRail, and YouTube Analytics.

Social and scheduling: read insights from Instagram, Facebook Pages, LinkedIn Pages, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, Google Business Profile, and WordPress — then schedule, publish, and reschedule posts across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, Threads, and Google Business Profile.

E-commerce and email: Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, Google Merchant Center, Klaviyo, and Mailchimp.

The value is the join. Ask Claude to put ad spend next to sessions next to orders and get one answer, across accounts that normally live in separate dashboards.

Bring your own data too: BigQuery, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQL Server with per-connection read-only or full access, plus Airtable, Notion, Google Sheets, and Slack. Custom REST APIs can be added as OpenAPI 3.x manifests.

Safe by default: reading and writing are separate tools, so read operations never modify your accounts. Everything runs under the permissions of the accounts you connect.

Requires an InsightfulPipe account with at least one connected source. Available platforms and actions depend on what you have authorized.

_published_faq.name: How do I add InsightfulPipe — Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, SEO, Social & Shopify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add InsightfulPipe — Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, SEO, Social & Shopify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://main.insightfulmcp.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.
